name: Proposal for a decision
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on the number and numerical strength of interparliamentary delegations
part_text:
The European Parliament has fixed how many members sit on each of its delegations to other countries and regions. These are the groups of Members of the European Parliament who meet regularly with politicians from places like the United States, China, Ukraine and many others. The decision sets a member number for every delegation, from 8 for Iraq and Afghanistan up to 78 for the joint assembly with African, Caribbean and Pacific states. It replaces an earlier decision from July 2024.

- Each country and regional delegation now has a fixed number of members, ranging from 8 to 78.
- It affects all Members of the European Parliament who sit on these delegations.
- The decision took effect on 17 September 2024, the day it was adopted.
